actions.script:
const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.PlanningServices.get#SprintDetail').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId || ''}).call() || {} ec.message.clearErrors() const L = (text) => ec.l10n.localize(text) const enc = (text) => String(text == null ? '' : text).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>').replace(/\u0022/g, '"') printUrl = '/apps/Projects/WorkItems/SprintReport?renderMode=html-print&workEffortId=' + encodeURIComponent(workEffortId || '') const sprint = out.detail if (!sprint) { printHtml = '

' + enc(L('This sprint is not available')) + '

'; return } const unit = sprint.unitLabel const fmt = (value) => value == null ? '' : ec.l10n.format(Math.round(Number(String(value)) * 100) / 100, '#,##0.##') const row = (label, value) => value ? '' + enc(L(label)) + '' + enc(value) + '' : '' const table = (heads, rows) => rows.length ? '' + heads.map((head) => '').join('') + '' + rows.map((cells) => '' + cells.map((cell) => '').join('') + '').join('') + '
' + enc(L(head)) + '
' + enc(cell) + '
' : '

' + enc(L('None')) + '

' const title = (text) => '
' + enc(L(text)) + '
' const rows = Array.from(sprint.rowList || []) const doneRows = rows.filter((item) => item.outcome === 'done') const openRows = rows.filter((item) => item.outcome === 'carried' || item.outcome === 'open') let velocity = [] try { velocity = Array.from(ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.ProjectReportServices.get#SprintVelocity').parameters({rootWorkEffortId: sprint.rootWorkEffortId, sprintCount: 6}).call()?.sprintList || []) } catch (err) { ec.logger.error(`Sprint report ${workEffortId}: no velocity: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`) } ec.message.clearErrors() printHtml = '
' + enc(sprint.workEffortName) + ' · ' + enc(sprint.projectName) + ' (' + enc(sprint.rootWorkEffortId) + ')
' + '

' + enc([L('Sprint report'), ec.l10n.format(ec.user.nowTimestamp, 'MMMM d, yyyy')].join(' · ')) + '

' + '' + row('Status', sprint.stateLabel) + row('Dates', sprint.datesText) + row('Started', sprint.startedText) + row('Completed on', sprint.completedDateText) + row('Goal', sprint.description) + row('Capacity', sprint.capacityText) + '
' + title('Numbers') + '' + row('Committed', sprint.committedText) + row('Added after the start', fmt(sprint.added) + ' ' + unit) + row('Removed after the start', fmt(sprint.removed) + ' ' + unit) + row('Completed', sprint.completedText) + row('Carried over', sprint.state === 'closed' ? fmt(sprint.carriedOver) + ' ' + unit : '') + row('Remaining', sprint.remainingText) + row('Days left', sprint.state === 'active' ? String(sprint.daysLeft) : '') + '
' + title('Burndown') + table(['Day', 'Remaining', 'Ideal'], Array.from(sprint.dayList || []).map((day) => [day.label, day.remainingText, day.idealText])) + title('Completed') + table(['Item', 'Type', 'Size', 'Assignees'], doneRows.map((item) => [item.workEffortId + ' ' + item.workEffortName, item.purposeLabel, item.sizeText, item.assigneeText || ''])) + title(sprint.state === 'closed' ? 'Carried over' : 'Not done yet') + table(['Item', 'Status', 'Size', 'Assignees'], openRows.map((item) => [item.workEffortId + ' ' + item.workEffortName, item.statusLabel, item.sizeText, item.assigneeText || ''])) + title('Scope changes') + table(['Item', 'Change', 'Size', 'When', 'By'], Array.from(sprint.scopeChangeList || []).map((change) => [change.workEffortId + ' ' + change.workEffortName, change.changeLabel, change.sizeText, change.dateText, change.byText])) + title('Velocity of the last sprints') + table(['Sprint', 'Committed', 'Added', 'Completed', 'Carried over'], velocity.map((one) => [one.workEffortName, fmt(one.committed), fmt(one.added), fmt(one.completed), fmt(one.carriedOver)]))

render-mode.text: ${JSON.stringify({t: "link", id: "SprintReportPrint", text: ec.l10n.localize("Open the printable sprint report"), url: printUrl})}
